messages:
Arjun: Heads up - starting ~06:12 UTC we saw a big batch of traces from model-service where downstream spans from tokenizer are missing. Root spans exist but children stop being ingested at the exporter layer. Anyone else seeing this?
Sophie: Can you paste a sample trace id and whether sampled=1? :eyes:
Arjun: trace_id=0af3d2e9... sampled=1 in the app logs. Logs show exporter accepting, then retention lookup failing. snippet: `2026-03-19T06:15:02Z INFO exporter.ingest trace_id=0af3d2e9 sampled=1 headers={"x-rw-trace-bucket":"v2"}`
Kai: on the exporter side we have warnings: `no-policy-for-bucket v2` then `dropped_by_retention=1` for those traces. Looks like routing -> retention mapping isn't finding v2.
TelemetryBot: metric exporter.ingest.queue_length increased from 12 -> 460 between 06:10-06:20 UTC (alerts: suppressed).
Sophie: Did we just rollout a headers-based routing change? I vaguely remember a routing rule PR last night.
Arjun: yes, rollout #2345 changed header matching: old rule used `x-rw-trace-bucket` -> retention:v1, new rules introduced a normalized key `trace-bucket` and a new value set `v2`. I think retention table wasn't populated for v2 yet. Diff: ```yaml
- match: headers.x-rw-trace-bucket == "v1"
+ match: headers.trace-bucket == "v2"
  route: retention_policy
```
Kai: ah — exporter code expects retention policy lookup by bucket name. If name unknown it drops spans (by design) and increments `dropped_by_retention`. That metric spiked.
platform-oncall: tagging @Arjun @Sophie, can we roll back the rollout that changed header name?
Arjun: I can roll back the proxy route in staging now and push a fix to map `x-rw-trace-bucket` -> `v2` until retention table populated. Quick mitigation: add a compatibility mapping in router config.
Sophie: Good plan. Also add a detection rule: when retention lookup fails, emit a debug log with header values (redacted) so next time it's faster.
Kai: Command I ran to view live drops: `kubectl logs deploy/exporter -c exporter | grep dropped_by_retention | tail -n 50` showed consistent `dropped_by_retention=1` for those trace_ids.
platform-oncall: rolling back route rollout now (rolling update). Status: starting.
TelemetryBot: deploy/exporter-router rollback started by platform-oncall at 06:29 UTC.
platform-oncall: rollback completed. queue length now 18 and ingestion errors falling. Dropped metric back to baseline.
Arjun: Confirmed: sampled traces from tokenizer are reappearing in traces UI, child spans attached again. :thumbsup:
Sophie: Follow-ups: 1) add compatibility mapping in router config 2) add unit/integration test for unknown-bucket -> fail-open to a default retention for short window 3) populate retention table for v2 or delay naming until live.
Kai: I'll open a PR for the compatibility mapping + tests and add a shortterm alert on `dropped_by_retention > 0` to page oncall.
Arjun: thanks all. Filing postmortem notes and linking PRs.
platform-oncall: marking incident resolved.
TelemetryBot: incident_duration=17m, peak_queue=462, dropped_spans_est=~3.4k
Sophie: nice quick rollback. We'll review the rollout checklist to make sure retention mappings are verified before routing changes.
